extracted.name: Texas Caviar
extracted.description: This Texas caviar with zesty Italian dressing is loaded with black-eyed peas, black beans, and veggies for a delicious dip served with tortilla chips.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix together tomatoes, black-eyed peas, black beans, Italian dressing, bell pepper, onion, green onions, jalapeño peppers, garlic, and coriander in a large bowl. Cover and chill salad in the refrigerator for about 2 hours.
Toss salad with desired amount of cilantro to serve.
